This position ensures the seamless operation, security, and performance of file and print infrastructure, directly contributing to the company's efficiency and productivity. # Detailed Responsibilities ### 1. File and Print Services Management - Manage and maintain file server infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, security, and availability. - Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot file sharing services such as Network Attached Storage (NAS) or cloud-based storage solutions. - Implement and maintain print server environments, including printer configuration, driver management, and print queue administration. ### 2. Technical Support - Provide second-level technical support to end-users and other IT support staff. - Diagnose and resolve issues related to file access, permissions, print failures, and network connectivity. - Collaborate with Level 1 support teams to escalate and resolve complex problems. ### 3. System Administration - Administer user accounts, groups, and permissions for file access, ensuring security and data integrity. - Implement backup and disaster recovery solutions for file and print services. - Monitor system performance and proactively address issues to prevent downtime. ### 4. Documentation and Training - Create and update documentation related to file and print services, including standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides. - Conduct training sessions for end-users and support staff on file and print services usage and best practices. ### 5.
